items.text: Odala ndi amene moyo wawo ulibe cholakwa,
amene amayenda monga mwa malamulo a Yehova.
Odala ndi amene amasunga malamulo ake,
amene amafunafuna Iyeyo ndi mtima wawo wonse.
Aa! Ndikanakonda njira zanga zikanakhala zokhazikika
Kodi mnyamata angathe bwanji kuyeretsa mayendedwe ake?
musalole kuti ndisochere kuchoka pa malamulo anu.
Ndasunga mawu anu mu mtima mwanga
Ndi milomo yanga ndimafotokoza malamulo anu onse
monga momwe munthu amakondwera akakhala ndi chuma chambiri.
Chitirani zokoma mtumiki wanu, ndipo ndidzakhala ndi moyo;
Tsekulani maso anga kuti ndithe kuona
Ine ndine mlendo pa dziko lapansi;
Ndinafotokoza njira zanga ndipo Inu munandiyankha;
ndayika malamulo anu pa mtima panga.
Mundipatse mtima womvetsa zinthu ndipo ndidzasunga malamulo anu
ndi kuwamvera ndi mtima wanga wonse.
Tembenuzani mtima wanga kuti uzikonda malamulo anu,
Tembenuzani maso anga kuchoka ku zinthu zachabechabe;
sungani moyo wanga monga mwa mawu anu.
Kwaniritsani lonjezo lanu kwa mtumiki wanu,
Chikondi chanu chosasinthika chibwere kwa ine, Inu Yehova,
chipulumutso chanu monga mwa lonjezo lanu;
Musakwatule mawu a choonadi mʼkamwa mwanga,
pakuti ndakhazikitsa chiyembekezo changa mʼmalamulo anu.
Ndidzayankhula za umboni wanu pamaso pa mfumu
Ndikweza manja anga ku malamulo anu, ku malamulo amene ndimawakonda,
Kumbukirani mawu anu kwa mtumiki wanu,
Chitonthozo changa pa masautso anga ndi ichi:
Zophunzitsa zanu ndi mitu ya nyimbo yanga
Ndimafunafuna nkhope yanu ndi mtima wanga wonse;
mundikomere mtima monga mwa lonjezo lanu.
ndipo ndatembenuza mayendedwe anga kutsatira umboni wanu.
Ndimadzuka pakati pa usiku kuyamika Inu
Ine ndine bwenzi la onse amene amakukondani,
kwa onse amene amatsatira malangizo anu.
Dziko lapansi ladzaza ndi chikondi chanu chosasinthika,
Inu Yehova, chitirani chabwino mtumiki wanu
Inu ndinu abwino ndipo zimene mumachita ndi zabwino;
ine ndimasunga malangizo anu ndi mtima wanga wonse.
Mitima yawo ndi yowuma ndi yosakhudzidwa,
koma ine ndimakondwera ndi malamulo anu.
Lamulo lochokera mʼkamwa mwanu limandikomera kwambiri
kuposa ndalama zambirimbiri za siliva ndi golide.
patseni nzeru zomvetsa zinthu kuti ndiphunzire malamulo anu.
chifukwa chiyembekezo changa chili mʼmawu anu.
Ine ndikudziwa, Inu Yehova, kuti malamulo anu ndi olungama
ndipo mwandizunza chifukwa cha kukhulupirika kwanu.
Chikondi chanu chosasinthika chikhale chitonthozo changa,
molingana ndi lonjezo lanu kwa mtumiki wanu.
Chifundo chanu chindifikire kuti ndikhale ndi moyo,
popeza malamulo anu ndiye chikondwerero changa.
Odzikuza achititsidwe manyazi chifukwa cha kundilakwira popanda chifukwa;
Iwo amene amakuopani atembenukire kwa ine,
Mtima wanga ukhale wopanda cholakwa pa chiphunzitso chanu
Moyo wanga wafowoka ndi kufunafuna chipulumutso chanu,
koma chiyembekezo changa chili mʼmawu anu.
Maso anga alefuka pofunafuna lonjezo lanu;
Ngakhale ndili ngati thumba lachikopa la vinyo pa utsi
Kodi mtumiki wanu ayenera kudikira mpaka liti?
odzikuza amandikumbira dzenje motsutsana ndi malamulo anu.
thandizeni, pakuti anthu akundizunza popanda chifukwa.
Iwo anatsala pangʼono kundichotsa pa dziko lapansi
Sungani moyo wanga molingana ndi chikondi chanu chosasinthika,
ndipo ndidzamvera umboni wa pakamwa panu.
Kukhulupirika kwanu kumakhala mpaka ku mibado yonse;
Inu munakhazikitsa dziko lapansi ndipo lilipobe.
Malamulo anu alipobe mpaka lero lino,
Malamulo anu akanapanda kukhala chikondwerero changa,
pakuti ndi malangizo anuwo munasunga moyo wanga.
Ndadziwa kuti zinthu zonse zili ndi malire,
koma malamulo anu alibe malire konse.
Malamulo anu amachititsa kuti ndikhale wanzeru kuposa adani anga,
popeza malamulowo ali ndi ine nthawi zonse.
Ndimamvetsa zinthu kwambiri kuposa aphunzitsi anga onse
Ndili ndi nzeru zochuluka zomvetsera zinthu kuposa anthu okalamba,
Ndimaletsa miyendo yanga kuyenda mʼnjira iliyonse yoyipa
Ndimapeza nzeru zodziwira zinthu kuchokera mʼmalangizo anu;
kotero ndimadana ndi njira iliyonse yoyipa.
Mawu anu ndi nyale ya kumapazi kwanga
ndi kuwunika kwa pa njira yanga.
Inu Yehova, sungani moyo wanga molingana ndi mawu anu.
Inu Yehova, landirani matamando aufulu ochokera pakamwa panga,
Ngakhale moyo wanga umakhala mʼzoopsa nthawi ndi nthawi,
koma sindinasochere kuchoka pa malangizo anu.
Umboni wanu ndiye cholowa changa kwamuyaya;
Iwo ndiye chimwemwe cha mtima wanga.
Mtima wanga wakhazikika pa kusunga zophunzitsa zanu
Inu ndinu pothawirapo panga ndi chishango changa;
Chokani kwa ine, inu anthu ochita zoyipa,
kuti ndisunge malamulo a Mulungu wanga!
Mundichirikize molingana ndi lonjezo lanu, ndipo ndidzakhala ndi moyo;
musalole kuti chiyembekezo changa chipite pachabe.
Inu mumakana onse amene amasochera kuchoka pa zophunzitsa zanu,
pakuti chinyengo chawo ndi chopanda phindu.
Anthu onse oyipa a pa dziko lapansi mumawayesa ngati zinthu zakudzala;
Thupi langa limanjenjemera chifukwa cha kuopa Inu;
Onetsetsani kuti mtumiki wanu akukhala bwino,
Maso anga alefuka, kufunafuna chipulumutso chanu,
Muchite naye mtumiki wanu molingana ndi chikondi chanu chosasinthika,
Ine ndine mtumiki wanu; patseni mzimu wondizindikiritsa,
Yehova, ndi nthawi yoti muchitepo kanthu;
kuposa golide, kuposa golide woyengeka bwino,
ndiponso chifukwa choti ndimaona kuti malangizo anu onse ndi wowongoka,
Ndimatsekula pakamwa panga ndi kupuma wefuwefu,
Tembenukirani kwa ine ndipo mundichitire chifundo,
monga mumachitira nthawi zonse kwa iwo amene amakonda dzina lanu.
Tsogolerani mayendedwe anga molingana ndi mawu anu;
Mitsinje ya misozi ikuyenda kuchoka mʼmaso mwanga,
chifukwa adani anu amanyalanyaza mawu anu.
Umboni wanu ndi wabwino nthawi zonse;
patseni nzeru zomvetsa zinthu kuti ine ndikhale ndi moyo.
Ndimayitana ndi mtima wanga wonse; ndiyankheni Inu Yehova,
Ndimadzuka tambala asanalire kuti ndipemphe thandizo;
Maso anga amakhala chipenyere nthawi yonse ya usiku,
Imvani mawu anga molingana ndi chikondi chanu chosasinthika;
Yehova sungani moyo wanga, molingana ndi malamulo anu.
Iwo amene amakonza njira zoyipa andiyandikira,
koma ali kutali ndi malamulo anu.
kuti maumboni amene munakhazikitsawo ndi amuyaya.
Mundiyimirire pa mlandu wanga ndi kundiwombola;
sungani moyo wanga molingana ndi lonjezo lanu.
Chipulumutso chili kutali ndi anthu oyipa,
sungani moyo wanga molingana ndi malamulo anu.
koma ine sindinatembenuke kuchoka pa umboni wanu.
sungani moyo wanga, Inu Yehova, molingana ndi chikondi chanu chosanthika.
malamulo anu onse olungama ndi amuyaya.
koma mtima wanga umanjenjemera ndi mawu anu.
ngati munthu amene wapeza chuma chambiri.
Ndimadana ndi chinyengo, kwambiri ndimanyansidwa nacho,
Ndimakutamandani kasanu ndi kawiri pa tsiku
Amene amakonda malamulo anu ali ndi mtendere waukulu,
Ndimamvera malangizo anu ndi umboni wanu,
pakuti njira zanga zonse ndi zodziwika pamaso panu.
Kulira kwanga kufike pamaso panu Yehova;
patseni nzeru zomvetsa zinthu molingana ndi mawu anu.
popeza malamulo anu onse ndi olungama.
Loleni kuti ndikhale ndi moyo kuti ndikutamandeni,
